title: Salesforce Crm Specialist
description: Position Overview: As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate. This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content. Key Responsibilities: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact. Client Journey: Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups. Data Segmentation and Hygiene: Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database. Testing & Quality Control: Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance. Operational Support: Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey. Platform Integrations: Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) 3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud Preferred Qualifications: Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries Familiarity with booking or practice management systems Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Solutions Architect
description: Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension) Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh, data products, and Unity Catalog–based governance. This is a hands-on architect role, requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Solution & Data Architecture Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration). Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products. Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog, including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions. Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Data Platform Design & Governance Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks. Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management. Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools. Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies. Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk. Remain hands-on with: Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

description: Job SummaryThe Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactivelyAssumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as requiredWork with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conductServe as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicatedParticipates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and ExperienceBachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).Experience managing clinical project team personnel.Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and AbilitiesStrong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.Ability to work with remote teams title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Analista De Crm Sênior
description:

Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de CRM Sênior, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Revenue e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente. Responsabilidades Como Analista Sênior, você será a referência técnica e estratégica do time de CRM. Seu papel será construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos e sustentáveis entre a SuperFrete e seus clientes. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar estratégias avançadas de personalização e comunicação, influenciando diretamente os resultados de conversão da empresa. Visão de dados: atuar na estratégia de unificação de dados dos clientes para garantir uma visão 360º, permitindo segmentações comportamentais avançadas e comunicações personalizadas. Comunicação multicanal: idealizar campanhas que sejam relevantes para o momento do empreendedor, cuidando da narrativa e do impacto da mensagem em canais como WhatsApp, push, e-mail e SMS. Uso estratégico do HubSpot: utilizar o potencial máximo das ferramentas de automação para viabilizar as estratégias de comunicação e otimizar as jornadas de relacionamento. Experimentação e testes AB: liderar uma rotina de testes para descobrir constantemente novas alavancas de crescimento e conversão. Análise e performance: monitorar KPIs de jornada e negócio através do HubSpot, Power BI e GA4, transformando dados em melhorias contínuas para a experiência do cliente. Colaboração e mentoria: colaborar com as equipes de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Atendimento para garantir a consistência dos processos;
Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de CRM compartilhando boas práticas. Inovação e melhoria de processos: acompanhar tendências de mercado, propondo novas soluções tecnológicas e abordagens para escalar a personalização e aprimorar a experiência do cliente através da automação de processos. Requisitos Experiência avançada em HubSpot, com foco em automação de marketing e análise de jornada para viabilizar projetos de comunicação;
Domínio de estratégiasde comunicação multicanal, incluindo WhatsApp, push, SMS e e-mail marketing, entendendo as particularidades e boas práticas de cada canal;
Habilidade em copywriting e narrativa, com capacidade de criar textos que engajam o pequeno e médio empreendedor, utilizando gatilhos e tom de voz adequados para conversão, além de desenvolver campanhas segmentadas e personalizadas com base no comportamento dos clientes;
Forte capacidade de análise de jornada e dados, com experiência na definição e monitoramento de KPIs de conversão e interpretação de dados para tomada de decisão;
Estratégia CDP& DMP: Compreensão de como a unificação de dados e a gestão de processos de negócio potencializam o CRM;
Experiência com ferramentas de mensuração e analytics, como Appsflyer, Firebase e GA4;
Experiência emgestão de projetos, com capacidade de estruturar e executar processos repetíveis, eficientes e escaláveis de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas. Diferenciais Experiência em startups e/ou empresas de tecnologia;

Buscamos excelência emtudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto. O que oferecemos

title: Program Coordinator

title: Ai Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-Time Remote, Br)
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

title: Administração De Dados - Sênior
description: Quem somos? Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil. O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito. Dia a dia Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco. Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção. Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time. Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas. Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia. Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados. Requisitos 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia. Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados. Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.). Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados). Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos. Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção. Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders. Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech. Diferenciais Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes. Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação. Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória. Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs). Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco. Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos. O que temos por aqui: Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP. Remuneração compatível (PJ). Benefício flexível via cartão Swile. Wellhub (antigo Gympass). Convênio médico Porto Saúde. Convênio odontológico Uniodonto.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas. O que Buscamos? O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework. ✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura - Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design - Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage - Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos - Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering Azure Files - Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS) - Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory - Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso - Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises - Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup Azure Networking – Conceitos principais - Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP - Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall - Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute - Private Endpoints e service endpoints - Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure ✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações - Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais ✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde ✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade - Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking - Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito - Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC - Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas Automação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados ✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure - Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura - Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização - Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede - Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros ✅ Perfil de Experiência - Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure - Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes - Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica - Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure - Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente Contratação CLT Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas) O que oferecemos? Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
Auxílio creche;
Convênio com Farmácia;
Parcerias comUniversidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
Gympass;
Seguro de Vida;
Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Immigration Paralegal
description: Company Description Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages. Role Description We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment. Key Responsibilities Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs) Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism Qualifications Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures Excellent organizational and time-management skills Strong written and verbal communication abilities Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only To Apply To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection. description: IMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer: An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

description:

Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade. Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças. Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo. Salário Regime: PJ Salário: Competitivo Nível: Especialista Principais responsabilidades Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema. Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features. Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades. Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release. Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade. Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade. Experiência com os testes automatizados Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado. Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK). Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares). Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home) Contract Duration: 12 months Number of Open Positions: 20 Key Qualifications Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorouslyevaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process - Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62131 as your email subject.

title: Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead.
